title: O Jesus Tuhanki
chord: Am · G · C · D · Em · Am · D7 · A
lyrics:
Anggo didongani Tuhan Jesus au
Salelengna mangingani Rura hasusaan au
Sonang do rohangku Ai huboto Jesus do donganku
Molo Tuhan Jesus Donganki tongtong
Bahenonku do maporus Na mangarop tondingkon
Sai martua iba Molo Tuhan Jesus donganniba

Sonang do rohangku Raphon Jesuski
Ai disesa do dosangku Dipabulus langkangki
Asa unang mago Tondingkon bahenon ni pangago
